notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.content:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: An ode to dreaming: Start of Uptasia‘s „Poets and Thinkers“ magic tower event
notes.content:
[b]Uptasia[/b]‘s latest event is dedicated to all the [i]poets and thinkers[/i].​

Starting [b]at noon on the 10th of January[/b], the newest Uptasia collection event asks you to [b]collect as many quills[/b] as you can so you may enlighten the world of Uptasia with stylish, thought-provoking decoration objects.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/7b468cedb45b94dd738d25a109a024d8cb0b0cfa.jpg[/img]

During the event you may exchange the collected quills for the usual like Magic Crystals or VIP-Points plus decorative objects like “[b]Bertold the Speaker[/b]” (40 decoration points) and the “[b]Tower of Knowledge[/b]” (180 points). The more industrious among you may even enjoy “[b]the Poet’s Refuge[/b]” (+2 max customers) and [b]Poet-Bianca[/b].

Enjoy Uptasia’s latest hidden objects event!

notes.title: Uptasia: Golden Hazelnuts for Bianca
notes.content:
[h1]This fairy tale event invites you to dream of princes and princesses
[/h1]

It has become a tradition that in wintertime, Uptasia’s Bianca watches the classical movie “Three wishes for Cinderella”, where a simple girl with the help of three magical golden hazelnuts becomesa princess.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/44155de81cb9021107352aa544abc51559684dbf.jpg[/img]

Romantically inclined as we are, we want to help Bianca to fulfill her dream to become a princess in her very own fairy-tale.

Of course three hazelnuts are not enough to do this – because in our version of the story, Bianca does not just settle for (just?) a prince but will be rewarded with palace “Biancaburg”.

All you have to do is to collect golden hazelnuts between now and December 18, noon CET - Your rewards include the Bozena-hazelnut bushes (10 decoration points), the „Stately Ride“ (180 decoration points), Biancas „Glory of the Snow“-avatar, as well as the „Biancaburg“ Palace as main prize. Of course you may also earn Magic Crystals, Puss- and VIP-points.

You may redeem your collected hazelnuts until December 20, noon CET.
Be enchanted by these magical moments.

notes.title: Experience the Camping Adventure
notes.content:
Warm summer nights, stars twinkling in the sky, and marshmallows roasting over a crackling fire - the new Magic Tower event [b]"Adventure Camp"[/b] has begun and lets you enjoy the loveliest time of the year.

Experience [b]wonderful hidden object games[/b] in the villa and collect [b]Adventure Badges[/b] until Tuesday, [b]July 31[/b], at 11:59 am CEST.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/3c05fd2403cf03c412a8ddae0d55ea5903baf691.jpg[/img]

Collecting enough will net you [b]outdoorsy prizes[/b], which you can pick up until Thursday, August 2nd, at 11:59 am CEST. These include the Canoe "Dugout", the bear "Kinai", VIP Points, the Tent Camp "Woodchucks" which increases your maximum number of customers by 2 per upgrade level, and the adventurous Scout Bianca with 3 Puss Points.

[b]Experience the adventure[/b] and have fun with the latest [b]Magic Tower event[/b].

notes.title: This Event Heralds Spring in Uptasia
notes.content:
It's getting brighter, warmer, and oh so much better. Experience [b]Spring[/b] in Uptasia with the new Magic Tower Event [b]"Into Spring"[/b], which runs until [b]Tuesday, March 13[/b] at 11:59 am CET. Solve [b]wonderful hidden object game[/b] in the villa and collect [b]Colorful Blossoms[/b].

 These will net you enchanting prizes which you can pick up until Thursday, March 15, at 11:59 am CET. These include "Clara and Rosa", Cat Power Bianca for your cat courier, a relaxing "Day in the City", VIP Points, and the glass house "Simone" which increases your maximum customers by 4 per upgrade level.

Check out the Magic Tower event and experience spring in Uptasia!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/fce2a73300b80f6e15de753d1ff7270246ea79a5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Love in the Magic Tower - Experience "Heartfelt Moments"
notes.content:
What a magical rendezvous! The scent of roses lies heavy in the air, and candles illuminate a romantic spread in soft light. A luxurious rose bush, beautiful candles and a romantic dinner - experience the [b]enchanting Magic Tower event "Heartfelt Moments"[/b]!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/bb3db4879ad235661d4578664dc76fd2e00cbc3b.jpg[/img]

 From now [b]until Tuesday, February 13[/b], at 12:00 pm CET, you can solve beautiful hidden object games in the villa. Collect [b]heart balloons[/b] to earn unique prizes, which you can pick up until Thursday, February 15 at 12:00 pm CET.

Rewards include a rose wall, a romantic dinner, VIP points, the lovely Delicate Rose Bianca (worth 3 Puss Points!) and the Tower House "Amica," which increases your maximum number of customers by 2 per upgrade level.

Stop by Uptasia today and experience this love-filled Magic Tower event! We wish you a [b]wonderful Valentine's Day[/b]!

notes.title: 24 Hours Only: Wonderful World Event (Feb 4th)
notes.content:
"Time flies, seize the day" was something even the Romans knew. It's the same in our new [b]world event[/b]. For a whole [b]24 hours[/b], you'll get [b]50 percent more resources[/b], and harvesting them will also be faster. Seize this opportunity to get the most out of your resources.

 This special one-day event begins on [b]Sunday, February 4[/b], at 12:01 am CET and ends on the same day at [b]11:59 pm CET[/b]. Come check it out!

 We wish you lots of fun, and a rich resource harvest!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/51fc5ab8f310ab553e511faf4c4693962bf455cc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Magic Tower Event "Urban Uptasia" Has Begun
notes.content:
Every city has its own rhythm. Sounds, noises, smells, music and people milling about everywhere you go. Experience the new [b]Magic Tower event "Urban Uptasia"[/b] and dive right into the [b]bustle of the city[/b]!

 Solve exciting hidden object games in the villa until [b]Tuesday, January 30[/b], at 12:00 pm CET to collect [b]Berets[/b] and earn [b]fabulous prizes[/b] which van be picked up until Thursday, February 1[/b], at 12:00 pm CET.

Get Jacques, Monsieur Bianca (with Puss Points[/b], a Pétanque Player, VIP Points and the impressive Tower "Fleur de la ville".

Experience the [b]urban bustle[/b]!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/e926b93463e01bf82627dede78b75c4b3b81db64.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fantastic Impressions, Adventures and Experiences!
notes.content:
A fantastic new fairytale event awaits you in Uptasia. Solve exciting hidden object games in the villa [b]until Tuesday, January 16[/b], at 12:00 pm CET.

The magic tower lets you participate at events that will be held at regular intervals. These events are split up into three phases: the phase of collecting, redeeming and a cooldown phase.

During the first phase, completing hidden object games will gain you collector's items valid only during the currently active event.

These collector's items will help you unlock rewards - a bronze reward, a silver reward and a gold reward. These rewards may be decorations or residential buildings you can place on your map.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461577/2b715ea9edf0ee4b1765578416c94a711e8beffc.jpg[/img]

With the theme of [b]"Fairytale Impressions"[/b], you'll encounter colorful folklore, frosty sagas and incredible buildings.

Find the required objects in pictures and collect [b]Matryoshkas[/b]. The more of these nesting dolls collect, the more wonderful [b]prizes[/b] you'll receive.

Pickup the prizes for your Matryoshkas until Thursday, January 18, at 12:00 pm CET - these include Grandfather Frost and Snowflake, a horse-drawn sleigh, the enchanting Bianca Biancova (2 Puss Points) for your cat courier, VIP points, and the impressive onion dome house "Luk", which increases your maximum number of customers by four per upgrade level.

Visit Uptasia and experience the [b]enchanting Magic Tower event[/b]!
